routes.notes: Operator terminals in Karachi, Lahore, Multan, Rawalpindi; exact city pairs not published. Sastaticket fares look stale and timetable is template filler.

open_questions: No official intercity fare notification published online for Punjab after 2018 (per-km non-AC only), or for KP, Balochistan, GB, AJK or ICT; Punjab 2026 route fares come from news reports of Transport Dept / RTA decisions.

Terminal names in the PTA Sindh list are city-level only (no terminal given); Karachi intercity buses leave from several addas (Sohrab Goth, Super Highway, Cantt/Taj Complex, Yousuf Goth, Northern Bypass Inter City Bus Terminal).
Daewoo's own fare and route AJAX endpoints (daewoo.com.pk/Home/GetFare, GetArrivalsByDeparture) returned empty lists on 2026-09-21; Daewoo fares/times are from third-party sites and conflict.
Departures per day and first/last departure are unknown for most operator routes; aggregator timetables (sastaticket) are shared templates and were not used.
Intermediate stops are known only for Daewoo's Karachi corridor (partial) and NATCO's KKH stops (order assumed geographically).
Coordinates missing for Daewoo Multan, Hyderabad and Moro terminals, Road Master and Q Connect terminals, NATCO Skardu/Karachi/Lahore points.
Waraich Express has no working official website; Kohistan and Manthar only have Facebook pages (login required).
Whether the NATCO Gilgit-Kashgar bus is running in 2026.
